name: Mount Dora
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Mount Dora?
answer_short: Yes, on city streets posted 30 mph or less. Mount Dora lets a registered golf cart use those streets unless a sign says no golf carts. County, state and federal roads, including Donnelly Street (US 441), are closed to carts and LSVs.

golf_cart.roads: City streets posted 30 mph or less
golf_cart.notes: Not on state or county roads

lsv.roads: City streets posted 35 mph or less, not state or county roads

rules.rule: Registered golf carts on a city right of way posted 30 mph or less, 24 hours, unless posted no golf carts
The ordinance does not allow a golf cart or LSV on a county, state or federal roadway
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections

banned_roads.name: Donnelly Street (US 441)
banned_roads.rule: State road; no golf carts or LSVs

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Mount Dora?
faq.a: City streets posted 35 mph or less, not state or county roads. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Donnelly Street?
faq.a: No. Donnelly Street is US 441, a state road, and the ordinance does not allow carts or LSVs on state roads.

faq.q: What is the golf cart speed cap in Mount Dora?
faq.a: 30 mph. A city street posted over 30 mph is closed to golf carts.
